initial_public_good_policy.validation_scope: Full release header and membership; all files of the ten selected package versions. No search preparation or full-catalogue body qualification.

advisory.changes: Main-header Public Good policy/browser, exact-version free account access, atomic limits and separate nonbillable delivery records. OAuth authorization code with S256 PKCE, explicit consent, scoped resource-bound tokens, refresh/downscope and revocation through existing identity and the pinned MCP SDK.
advisory.live_oauth_scope: An existing engineering customer signed in, explicitly authorized a new QA client, initialized MCP, searched, retrieved and hash-verified one 2363-byte instruction file, refreshed/downscoped and revoked the new QA delegation. Paid usage and entitlement were unchanged. The account holds founding_free_monthly access, so this is not an unpaid production-account proof; unpaid refusal/isolation is covered by synthetic HTTP and browser tests. Callback URI was validated, not navigated by a real dot.
advisory.failed_attempts: Earlier CI failed SDK exception handling on Python 3.12 and exact issuer metadata. The production Python 3.12 image then passed 50 focused tests. Live browser attempts retained a coordinator deadline, transient documentation/module loading errors, a wrong expected query count and an invalid asset comparison made against a newer dirty tree. The final examples-host check used the unchanged deployed web-asset snapshot and passed 201/201; combined final host results are 2118/2118, not one failure-free attempt.
advisory.policy_maintenance: Two full-loader read-only plans timed out at 180 seconds; no policy was applied by them. The selected operator validates canonical header/schema/membership and exact selected files, then invokes the existing digest/CAS policy writer. Its live plan took 0.2041 seconds and apply 0.1652 seconds. This is an observed maintenance reduction, not a search latency benchmark.
advisory.remaining: The first policy does not meet 1000 files or all-17-SDG coverage. Individual-file browsing, larger access selection, five independently admitted originals, full activity history, two-way dot submissions, marketplace publication and video-to-harness recreation remain separate delivery work. No model call, purchase, infrastructure resize or legal notice change occurred in the deployment.
